name: Basic Prototype Development Laboratory for Electrical Engineering DIY 0
description: To understand the basics of Product Development Life Cycle (PDLC) and basic prototyping for both software and hardware projects; to work as teams to build and demonstrate at least one prototype using PDLC, and associated management and technical software; familiarisation with the on-campus facilities for simulation, fabrication of the prototype built. This is primarily offered as a Summer Course for UG students of any discipline (including EE Dept) who have typically completed up to the first four semesters of course work and are interested in hands-on DIY activity for building prototypes of electrical systems and sub-systems for applications in their parent disciplines.
